content:
Tomislav Mesarić
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia
+385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

Dear FreshCart Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant position at FreshCart’s Zagreb-Jarun store. I am a qualified butcher with nine years of experience in high-street and market butchery, along with HACCP basic food hygiene training renewed in 2024.

In my current role at Mesnica Kod Ante, I break down beef and pork, bone, trim and portion meat for the counter, and prepare four kinds of fresh sausage. I also keep temperature records for the cold room and display counter, completing checks twice daily. This experience aligns closely with your need for careful meat preparation and consistent HACCP temperature and hygiene checks.

Customer service is also central to my work. I serve around 120 customers on a typical Saturday and advise them on cuts and cooking times. I would bring that practical product knowledge to FreshCart’s “Ask the counter” approach, together with experience serving customers, weighing and pricing orders, and handling cash. I have also trained two apprentices in safe knife handling and cleaning routines.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my butchery experience and attention to hygiene could contribute to the Zagreb-Jarun meat counter. Thank you for considering my application.

Yours sincerely,
Tomislav Mesarić

critique.content_quality_feedback: The cover letter is concise, professional, and well structured. It opens with the target role, establishes the candidate’s relevant qualifications, gives concrete evidence from current and previous work, and closes appropriately. Specific figures—nine years of experience, four sausage types, twice-daily temperature checks, approximately 120 Saturday customers, and two apprentices trained—make the application credible and impactful. The tone also fits FreshCart’s emphasis on product knowledge, helpful customer service, and hygiene. There are no apparent unsupported claims or material hallucinations when cross-referenced with the original candidate information.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The letter is ATS-friendly: it uses standard headings-free letter formatting, readable paragraphs, the target job title, employer name, location, butcher terminology, HACCP, temperature records, customer service, weighing, pricing, and cash handling. AI and ATS screening probability is high for the two must-have requirements because the letter clearly connects butcher experience and HACCP training to the role. A small keyword improvement would be to state the completed butcher training and HACCP knowledge using wording closer to the advertisement. The letter appropriately does not claim a forklift licence, FIFO experience, stock-level responsibility, or packaging experience that is not present in the candidate information.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The document is a strong match for the role. It shows completed vocational butcher training, nine years of relevant meat-counter experience, HACCP-related temperature-recording experience, fresh sausage preparation, customer advice on cuts and cooking times, cash handling, and experience training others in safe working practices. The reference to FreshCart’s “Ask the counter” approach is well targeted and supported by the candidate’s customer-service experience. Forklift licence is a nice-to-have and is not shown in the candidate’s material; this is a candidate gap rather than a defect in the letter. The job ad also mentions packaging, FIFO stock rotation, counter-stocking targets, and self-service shelves, but the candidate information does not establish experience in those areas, so the letter should not claim them.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR ATS/ALIGNMENT ENHANCEMENT: In the opening paragraph, replace "I am a qualified butcher with nine years of experience in high-street and market butchery, along with HACCP basic food hygiene training renewed in 2024" with "I have completed vocational butcher training and have nine years of experience in high-street and market butchery, with HACCP knowledge supported by a basic food hygiene certificate renewed in 2024." This uses the advertisement’s terms more directly while remaining fully supported by the candidate information.

MINOR KEYWORD ENHANCEMENT: In the second paragraph, change "I break down beef and pork, bone, trim and portion meat for the counter" to "I break down beef and pork carcasses, bone, trim and portion fresh meat for the service counter." This more closely reflects the candidate’s documented experience and the job advertisement’s terminology without adding unsupported duties.

requirements.requirement: Completed butcher training or at least 2 years at a meat counter

HACCP basic food hygiene training renewed in 2024
